record: P4S-31D1-E — VoiceNote Artifact Binding + Mobile Consent UX contract
supersedes_diagnosis: P4S-31D1-C fixed the capture path (suspended AudioContext -> zero PCM). This packet fixes a DIFFERENT, deeper bug surfaced once capture worked: the local MediaRecorder blob (playback) and the live WS PCM16 stream (STT) are two DIVERGENT artifacts. Playback works (blob is good) while transcription reports 'no audio received' (WS stream was empty). The blob must be the single source of truth.

two_capture_paths: WS PCM16 stream -> umh/voice_server.py -> STT (this is what finalTranscriptText comes from)
MediaRecorder blob on the SAME MediaStream -> local playback + upload
root_cause.the_bug: voice-controller._finalizeRecording completes the transcript ONLY `if (finalTranscriptText)` (the WS path). When the WS stream produced nothing, the draft has a perfectly playable blob but no transcript, and the server reports no audio. There was no blob-fallback for the PRIMARY transcription — only the retry path used the blob.
root_cause.the_fix: When the WS stream yields no transcript on finalize, transcribe FROM THE ATTACHED BLOB using the same decode->resample->STT mechanism the retry path already proved. Centralize that mechanism in ONE shared helper used by both finalize-fallback and retry.

voicenote_draft.note: The canonical VoiceNoteDraft IS the existing store type VoiceMessageDraft (cockpit/src/renderer/stores/voiceMessageStore.ts). Do NOT rename it; VoiceNoteDraft is an alias for the same object.

fields.draft_id: vmd-<uuid> — stable id threaded through playback/transcribe/send/delete
fields.audioBlob: Blob | null — the SINGLE source of truth artifact
fields.audioUrl: string | null — local object URL for playback (local_object_url)
fields.content_type: string — mime_type, server-derived on upload, never client filename

single_artifact_source_of_truth.no_stale_split: There must be no separate audio state for playback vs transcription. One blob, one object URL.
single_artifact_source_of_truth.object_url_lifecycle: Created once on attachAudio; revoked ONLY on delete — never on transcription failure (preserved for retry).

binding_error_taxonomy.law: NEVER show 'No audio was received' / 'no audio' when draft.audioBlob.size > 0. Emit a precise, distinct code.
binding_error_taxonomy.authority: This is the ONE canonical local error vocabulary. No packet (#253/#254/#255 or later) may introduce a different local error code. The controller emits ONLY these; the RightRail failure map covers EXACTLY these; new codes require editing THIS list first.

codes.LOCAL_AUDIO_PRESENT_UPLOAD_MISSING: blob exists locally but the upload request carried no audio field
codes.LOCAL_AUDIO_PRESENT_SERVER_BYTES_EMPTY: sent, but the server received 0 bytes
codes.AUDIO_ARTIFACT_REF_NOT_FOUND: artifact_ref referenced but not resolvable server-side
codes.MISSING_AUDIO_FIELD: the draft has no audio field at all
codes.EMPTY_AUDIO_BLOB: blob present but size 0 (NEVER used when blob.size > 0 / playback works)
codes.DECODE_FAILED: decode of a real (size > 0) blob failed
codes.SILENT_AUDIO: decoded audio is present but effectively silent (mean energy below floor)
codes.VAD_NO_SPEECH: decoded, non-silent audio, but STT found no speech

transcript_dropdown_ui.requirement: Transcript is a collapsible/expandable dropdown UNDER the audio card. Long transcripts live in the collapsible body and do not flood the chat thread. User can manually expand/collapse.

mobile_safari_consent.wrong: mic tap -> browser permission -> SEPARATE 'Enable Push-to-Talk' click before recording (double consent)
mobile_safari_consent.correct: mic tap ONCE -> browser mic permission (if needed) -> on success, AUTOMATICALLY request the UMH push_to_talk grant in the SAME user-initiated flow -> record/ready. Explicit 'Enable Push-to-Talk' affordance ONLY if the SERVER grant fails.
rules: NO auto-grant without the user's mic tap

input_vs_action_approval.voice_input_consent: once per device/session/permission model — never a per-note approval
input_vs_action_approval.action_approval: later, only if the voice message becomes an operational command (held gate / proof)
input_vs_action_approval.rule: Manual Cockpit approval is for execution/gates, NOT for recording a voice note.

before_send: delete removes the draft cleanly + revokes object URL
on_explicit_send_only: finalized transcript enters Cockpit Chat (via sendDraft -> addVoiceTranscript, the sole entry)

acceptance: tap mic once (mobile Safari or desktop Chrome), grant browser mic permission if needed, record
transcript appears in a collapsible dropdown (from the BLOB, even if the WS stream was empty)
explicit Send commits transcript into Cockpit Chat -> IntentSpec -> gate/proof
playable local audio but missing upload field -> LOCAL_AUDIO_PRESENT_UPLOAD_MISSING
playable local audio but zero server bytes -> LOCAL_AUDIO_PRESENT_SERVER_BYTES_EMPTY
delete before send -> no chat entry, no intent entry
transcript edit before send -> the edited transcript is the one sent
browser mic permission granted -> push_to_talk grant without a second click
NEVER 'No audio was received' while local playback works
